text:
Situation: Amikacin sulfate 250 mg/mL 4 mL single-dose vials are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 149 vials with 4.3 vials used per day, providing 34.4 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show amikacin sulfate is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 34 days. No manufacturer labels identify a production plant. Five suppliers are available and none appear on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place order with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. as alternate source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as alternate source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Qilu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and Sagent Pharmaceuticals for future diversification; requires buyer approval.
5. Pharmacy director to review inventory weekly and report days on hand to P&T committee; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or allocation restrictions at this time.
